revision.description: 0 for first draft; +1 for every rewrite (dedup or QA routed).

hook.description: First line a reader sees: slide 1 text and first caption line.

headline.description: The post's core statement. May equal the hook on a single_post.

hook_family.description: Used by analytics to compare hook types. Pick the closest one.

kicker.description: Optional short label above the headline (a few words).

headline.description: The large statement on the slide. Optional on body slides where only text is needed, but required on slide 1.

text.description: Body copy. Line breaks with \n. Mini-format understood by templates: a line starting '→ ' is a bullet, a line starting '> ' is a closing pull-quote, a blank line is a paragraph break. On a cover, text is the sub-line; on a quote card, line 1 is the attribution.

note.description: Optional small extra line (a 'swipe' cue, a save prompt). Not every layout uses it.

emphasis_text.description: Optional phrase the art director should emphasize. Must appear verbatim in headline (preferred) or text.

caption.description: Full Instagram caption without hashtags. Plain text, real line breaks, no HTML.

alt_text.description: Accessibility description of the post for the Instagram alt-text field.

verbatim_quotes.description: Every string presented as a direct workbook quotation, in any slide or the caption. Deterministically checked against books/building_tomorrow/chapters/. Empty array if the post quotes nothing.

chapter_references.description: Every explicit chapter mention ('In Chapter 4...') so fake references can be checked.

dedup.description: Filled by tools/dedup_check.py, not by the model.

self_check.description: The copywriter's own pre-flight against brand/voice.md.
